roman_informal: anaupacharika yasale sketaralai ghumaunchha. yadi sketsa dayantira jhukeko chha bhane, sketara dayantira pharkanchha, yadi sketsa bayantira jhukeko chha bhane, sketara bayantira pharkanchha.
en_from_formal: < formal > This turns the skater. If the skates are tilted to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates are tilted to the left, the skater turns left.
en_from_informal: < informal > This turns the skater. If the skates are tilted to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates are tilted to the left, the skater turns left.

english: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.
ne_formal: <औपचारिक> आफ्नो अघिल्लो ऊर्जा स्तरमा फर्कन, तिनीहरूले प्रकाशबाट प्राप्त अतिरिक्त ऊर्जाबाट छुटकारा पाउनुपर्छ।
ne_informal: <अनौपचारिक> आफ्नो अघिल्लो ऊर्जा स्तरमा फर्कन, तिनीहरूले प्रकाशबाट प्राप्त अतिरिक्त ऊर्जाबाट छुटकारा पाउनुपर्छ।
roman_formal: aupacharika aaphno aghillo urja starama pharkana, tiniharule prakashabata prapta atirikta urjabata chhautakara paunuparchha.
roman_informal: anaupacharika aaphno aghillo urja starama pharkana, tiniharule prakashabata prapta atirikta urjabata chhautakara paunuparchha.

en_from_informal: To return to their previous energy levels, they must get rid of the excess energy they receive from light.

english: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".
ne_formal: <औपचारिक> तिनीहरूले "फोटोन" भनिने प्रकाशको सानो कण उत्सर्जित गरेर यो गर्छन्।
ne_informal: <अनौपचारिक> तिनीहरूले "फोटोन" भनिने प्रकाशको सानो कण उत्सर्जित गरेर यो गर्छन्।
roman_formal: aupacharika tiniharule photona bhanine prakashako sano kana utsarjita garera yo garchhan.
roman_informal: anaupacharika tiniharule photona bhanine prakashako sano kana utsarjita garera yo garchhan.
en_from_formal: They do this by emitting tiny particles of light called "photons."
en_from_informal: They do this by emitting tiny particles of light called "photons."

english: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.
ne_formal: वैज्ञानिकहरूले यस प्रक्रियालाई "विकिरणको उत्तेजित उत्सर्जन" भन्छन् किनभने परमाणुहरू उज्यालो प्रकाशद्वारा उत्तेजित हुन्छन्, जसले प्रकाशको फोटोनको उत्सर्जन निम्त्याउँछ, र प्रकाश एक प्रकारको विकिरण हो।
ne_informal: वैज्ञानिकहरूले यस प्रक्रियालाई "विकिरणको उत्तेजित उत्सर्जन" भन्छौ किनभने परमाणुहरू उज्यालो प्रकाशद्वारा उत्तेजित हुन्छौ, जसले प्रकाशको फोटोनको उत्सर्जन निम्त्याउँछ, र प्रकाश एक प्रकारको विकिरण हो।
roman_formal: waijञanikaharule yasa prakriyalai wikiranako uttejita utsarjana bhanchhan kinabhane paramanuharu ujyalo prakashadwara uttejita hunchhan, jasale prakashako photonako utsarjana nimtyaunchha, ra prakasha eka prakarako wikirana ho.
roman_informal: waijञanikaharule yasa prakriyalai wikiranako uttejita utsarjana bhanchhaau kinabhane paramanuharu ujyalo prakashadwara uttejita hunchhaau, jasale prakashako photonako utsarjana nimtyaunchha, ra prakasha eka prakarako wikirana ho.
en_from_formal: Scientists call this process "excited emission of radiation" because atoms are excited by bright light, which causes the emission of photons of light, and light is a type of radiation.
en_from_informal: Scientists call this process "excited emission of radiation" because atoms are excited by bright light, which causes the emission of photons of light, and light is a type of radiation.

english: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.
ne_formal: <औपचारिक> अर्को चित्रले फोटोनहरू उत्सर्जन गर्ने परमाणुहरू देखाउँछ। निस्सन्देह, वास्तविकतामा फोटोनहरू चित्रमा भन्दा धेरै साना हुन्छन्।
ne_informal: <अनौपचारिक> अर्को चित्रले फोटोनहरू उत्सर्जन गर्ने परमाणुहरू देखाउँछ। निस्सन्देह, वास्तविकतामा फोटोनहरू चित्रमा भन्दा धेरै साना हुन्छन्।

en_from_formal: < formal > Another diagram shows atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are much smaller than in the picture.
en_from_informal: Another picture shows atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are much smaller than in the picture.

english: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!
ne_formal: <औपचारिक> फोटोनहरू परमाणुहरू बनाउने सामग्रीहरूभन्दा पनि साना हुन्छन्!
ne_informal: <अनौपचारिक> फोटोनहरू परमाणुहरू बनाउने सामग्रीहरू भन्दा पनि साना हुन्छन्!

ne_informal: सयौँ घण्टाको सञ्चालनपछि बल्बको फिलामेन्ट अन्ततः जलेको हुन्छ र लाइट बल्बले काम गर्दैन।

roman_informal: sayaun ghantako saञchalanapachhai balbako philamenta antata jaleko hunchha ra laita balbale kama gardaina.

en_from_informal: After hundreds of hours of operation, the bulb's filament eventually burns out and the light bulb does not work.

ne_informal: <अनौपचारिक> रगत मुटुबाट धमनी भनिने ट्युबहरूमा जान्छ र शिराहरू भनिने ट्युबहरूमा मुटुमा फर्कन्छ। सबैभन्दा सानो ट्युबहरूलाई केशिकाहरू भनिन्छ।
roman_formal: aupacharika ragata mutubata dhamani bhanine tyubaharuma janchha ra shiraharu bhanine tyubaharuma mutuma pharkanchha. sabaibhanda sano tyubaharulai keshikaharu bhaninchha.

roman_informal: anaupacharika euta traiseratapsako dantale pata matra hoina, dherai kada shakha ra jara pani kulchana sakne thiyo.

en_from_informal: A Triceratops tooth could crush not only leaves, but also very hard branches and roots.

roman_informal: kehi waijञanikaharu traiseratapsale saikadaharu khae bhanne sochchhaau, juna eka prakarako bota ho juna kreteshiyasama samanya thiyo.

en_from_informal: Some scientists think that Triceratops ate cycads, a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

ne_formal: यद्यपि केही विद्वानहरूले अनुमान गर्छन् कि अहिले सुकेको सरस्वती नदीको बेसिनमा पनि सभ्यता अवस्थित थियो, यसलाई उचित रूपमा सिन्धु-सरस्वती सभ्यता भन्नुपर्छ, जबकि कसैले यसलाई हडप्पा पछि हडप्पा सभ्यता भन्छन्, जुन यसको पहिलो साइटहरू मध्ये 1920 मा उत्खनन गरिएको थियो।
